payload.explanation: Diagnostic report_aaba15d3f05c identifies the business request session_6f0bc72e72cb waiting on Lock:transactionid, blocked by session_dbbd99260e63, an idle-in-transaction session holding an uncommitted UPDATE on the same inventory row. State report_6112e522c45c confirms session_dbbd99260e63 is eligible for rollback_session under policy, while the business request session is not modifiable. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock, allowing the pending decrement to complete (stock 100 -> 99) without modifying the business request or unrelated transactions.
